notes: mc RATES risk-free 4.98% (FRED DGS10, 2026-10-29) and implied ERP 4.20% (Damodaran, 2026-10-01; re-checked on his page 2026-11-01, still the latest) kept from prefetch; ERP page states treasury 5.29% for its own date, a different basis from the FRED 4.98%.

mc GEOGRAPHY revenue is by customer HQ: US 74% FY2025 (66% FY2024, 62% FY2023), UK 10% FY2025 (11% FY2024), rest of world 16% (23% FY2024); no other country 10% or more. US 81% in Q2 2026 (73% in Q2 2025), 80% H1 2026. Rest of world fell from 27% to 19% of the quarter's revenue as US grew faster (pf_10k_20260217, pf_10q_20260804). The UK is shown only in the 10-K; the 10-Q groups it in rest of world.
mc GEOGRAPHY long-lived assets by region are not disclosed in the 10-K or 10-Q text read (asset-light software company, no region table): gap, not estimated.

mc EXPOSURE US government concentration: government segment revenue Q2 2026 $990.0M of $1,935.5M (51%), H1 $1,848.4M of $3,568.0M (52%) (10-Q note 12, pf_10q_20260804). Contracts carry termination-for-convenience, options cannot be exercised more than one year ahead, and funding lapses or shutdowns and efficiency drives are listed risks (10-Q Item 1A). Candidate bear mechanism: US federal budget or contracting change, sized from the 52% government share (the US-customer share is 80%).
mc EXPOSURE customer concentration: top three customers were 16% of revenue in H1 2026 (17% in H1 2025); the top-twenty average rose to $124M TTM, up 67% (pf_10q_20260804).

mc EXPOSURE export controls and sanctions: offerings are subject to US export controls and sanctions with encryption; violations could cost export privileges and government-sales eligibility (10-Q risk factors). No share of revenue is quantified: hypothesis, unsized. Company states it does not sell to the Chinese Communist Party or host platforms in China, and has no revenue from Russia or Palestinian territories (10-Q); China is a self-chosen zero, not a risk to current revenue.

mc EXPOSURE conflict zones: 10-Q lists Ukraine, Israel and the Middle East incl. recent escalation of hostilities in Iran; operations there are stated as not material to financial results. Unsized beyond that statement.

mc EXPOSURE Europe data sovereignty: press leads (TechTimes 2026-10-15, citing a 19-outlet investigation) report European contracts above EUR 500M combined and CLOUD Act access concerns; a Dutch pension fund ABP divested. Unconfirmed at source, not independent syndication-wise: hypothesis for the non-US 20% of revenue, unsized.

mc EXPOSURE legal: securities class action (Colorado, filed 2022) listed in 10-Q note 7, company expects no material adverse impact; law-firm solicitation after the Oct 2025 NGC2 memo drop (lead only, not a filed case in the sources read); American Oversight FOIA suit (Apr 2026) is about federal records, not a claim against the company; Zurich commercial court ruled for Republik on 22 of 23 counts in Palantir's suit (2026-06-12 per IPI).
mc EXPOSURE tariffs: only the generic forward-looking mention of tariffs; software revenue, no goods supply chain or Taiwan exposure disclosed. No evidenced size.

mc NEWS filings since the latest periodic report (10-Q filed 2026-08-04): none other found in identity.json filings; the only 8-K after the 10-K besides results is Item 5.07 filed 2026-06-09 (annual meeting vote). prefetch reuse says new_filings_since is empty for 2026-10-27; SEC was not re-queried by this lane for 2026-10-28 to 2026-11-01 (gap).

mc NEWS 2026-08-04 (press lead): Pentagon memo to spend up to about $244M on Palantir through March 2027 without competitive bidding, with services to be funded for April 2027 to December 2028 (Federal News Network, search excerpt; confirm at source).

mc NEWS 2026-09 (press lead, secondary excerpt, date approximate): Army TITAN ground-station award of eight systems around Sept 1; NATO NCIA finalized Maven Smart System NATO acquisition (value undisclosed); NATO air command and control award July 7, 2026 shared with Anduril and Athea SAS. Not confirmed at source.

mc NEWS 2026-01-28 (press lead): UK MoD agreed an enterprise deal, GBP 240.6M direct award under a defence and security exemption, three-year term from April 1 (The Register, Find a Tender notice 006344-2026); relevant to the UK 10% of FY2025 revenue.

mc NEWS 2026-10 (press leads, aggregator, not independent): stock closed 186.03 on Oct 16 after a 7.2% fall tied to an AI-financing selloff in software, 201.72 on Oct 21, 198.73 on Oct 27; new all-time high on Oct 9 per aggregator; Knox Systems federal-cloud partnership Oct 19; POSCO Future M Foundry/AIP contract Oct 21; Goldman upgrade to Buy ($230) Oct 8, Mizuho target $245 Oct 15 (analyst items are opinions, not facts). One aggregator line states FY2026 revenue guidance of $8.150-8.158B: unverified here, gather_documents owns guidance from the release.

mc NEWS results-day gap: Q3 2026 results are expected 2026-11-02 (one day after as_of); they are not citable and not in this run. Options-implied move was described as sizable in press; no figure was retrieved.
